name: Arena of Thebes
source:
Arena of Thebes is an adult gay visual novel.  Its focus lies on atmospheric and filmic storytelling. This means lots of fully fleshed out cg artworks supported by atmospheric sounds. Arena of Thebes is a kinetic novel and has therefore no player choices impacting the story at this time.

[From [url=https://milojunior.itch.io/arenaofthebes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
底比斯竞技场是一部成人同性恋视觉小说。它的重点在于氛围和电影般的故事讲述。这意味着大量由大气声音支持的完全充实的计算机图形艺术作品。底比斯竞技场是一部动态小说，因此目前没有影响故事的玩家选择。

[来自[url=https://milojunior.itch.io/arenaofthebes]Itch.io[/url]]
